### `Selector`

A selector (spec 5 §5.7.2).

One of:

- object {`by`, `units`, `start`, `end`, `offset`, `amount`, `shape`, `smoothness`, `easeHigh`, `easeLow`, `randomizeOrder`, `seed`, `mode`, `type`}: Range selector.
- object {`by`, `maxAmount`, `minAmount`, `wigglesPerSecond`, `correlation`, `temporalPhase`, `spatialPhase`, `lockDimensions`, `seed`, `mode`, `type`}: Wiggly selector (P2).
- object {`by`, `amount`, `mode`, `type`}: Expression selector (P2).
- object {`by`, `skipSpaces`, `start`, `each`, `amount`, `dur`, `ease`, `direction`, `from`, `distribution`, `seed`, `mode`, `type`}: Stagger selector (what text-unit tweens compile to).

### `Shadowlets`

Self-shadowing (spec 9 §9.8 `render.shadowlets`): a light of the comp darkens each particle
by the particles between it and the light, through a low-resolution density volume.

|---|---|---|---|
| `light` | `Id` | yes | A light layer of the comp. |
| `opacity` | `Scalar` \| null | no | Percent of darkening at full density. Default 30. |
| `softness` | `Scalar` \| null | no | Percent: how much the density volume is blurred. Default 40. |
| `colorize` | `ColorValue` \| null | no | The shadow's tint (black darkens). Default black. |
| `resolution` | `Integer` \| null | no | Cells per side of the density volume, 8–128. Default 64. |

Unknown fields are rejected (`doc.unknown_field`).

### `ShapeItem`

A shape item (spec 4 §4.1). Every item has `id`, `name`, `enabled`.

One of:

- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `contents`, `transform`, `anchor`, `position`, `scale`, `rotation`, `opacity`, `skew`, `skewAxis`, `blend`, `type`}: Container (spec 4 §4.2).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `direction`, `size`, `position`, `roundness`, `fitTo`, `type`}: Rectangle (spec 4 §4.4.1).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `direction`, `size`, `position`, `type`}: Ellipse (spec 4 §4.4.2).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `direction`, `kind`, `points`, `outerRadius`, `innerRadius`, `outerRoundness`, `innerRoundness`, `rotation`, `position`, `type`}: Polystar (spec 4 §4.4.3).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `direction`, `path`, `d`, `points`, `transform`, `pointTransform`, `pointsTransform`, `closed`, `smooth`, `morph`, `type`}: Path (spec 4 §4.4.4). Exactly one of `path`, `d`, and `points`.
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `color`, `opacity`, `rule`, `blend`, `composite`, `type`}: Fill (spec 4 §4.6.1).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `color`, `width`, `opacity`, `lineCap`, `lineJoin`, `miterLimit`, `dashes`, `dashOffset`, `taper`, `wave`, `blend`, `composite`, `type`}: Stroke (spec 4 §4.6.2).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `gradient`, `opacity`, `rule`, `blend`, `composite`, `type`}: Gradient fill (spec 4 §4.6.3).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `gradient`, `width`, `opacity`, `lineCap`, `lineJoin`, `miterLimit`, `dashes`, `dashOffset`, `taper`, `wave`, `blend`, `composite`, `type`}: Gradient stroke (spec 4 §4.6.3, P2).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `start`, `end`, `offset`, `mode`, `type`}: Trim paths (spec 4 §4.8.1).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `copies`, `offset`, `composite`, `transform`, `type`}: Repeater (spec 4 §4.8.2).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `radius`, `type`}: Round corners (spec 4 §4.8.3).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `amount`, `lineJoin`, `miterLimit`, `copies`, `copyOffset`, `type`}: Offset paths (spec 4 §4.8.4).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `size`, `ridges`, `per`, `points`, `type`}: Zig zag (spec 4 §4.8.5, P2).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `amount`, `type`}: Pucker and bloat (spec 4 §4.8.6, P2).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `angle`, `center`, `type`}: Twist (spec 4 §4.8.7, P2).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `size`, `detail`, `points`, `wigglesPerSecond`, `correlation`, `temporalPhase`, `spatialPhase`, `seed`, `type`}: Wiggle paths (spec 4 §4.8.8, P2).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `mode`, `type`}: Merge paths (spec 4 §4.8.9).
- object {`id`, `name`, `enabled`, `amount`, `direction`, `type`}: Feather (spec 4 §4.8.10, P3).
